convert_rst_file_to_mdx: convert an RST documentation file to MDX markdown format with internal reference shortening
convert_rst_docstrings_in_file: convert all RST docstrings in a Python source file to Markdown format
convert_rst_docstring_to_markdown: convert a single RST docstring to Markdown with indent preservation and tag removal
shorten_internal_refs: shorten internal API references like [`~transformers.Trainer`] to [`Trainer`] in documentation content
run_convert_command_cli: run the doc builder convert CLI command to convert RST or Python files to Markdown
